description: Accept an invitation to a pro ask: a link or the ask's number. As the account you act for when connected, else as this key. The builder hears you accepted, and your room with them opens with their note first; a link becomes yours, so nobody else can use it. Someone who is not a verified pro is refused, and the link stays open. Previews; `confirm: true` accepts, once the person says yes. Spends nothing.

confirm.description: false (the default) previews; true accepts, once the person has said yes.

invitation.description: The invitation: its link (…/i/…), or the pro ask's number (my_invitations shows it).

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

name: accept_invitation
title: Accept an invitation to a pro ask
